question: At which international forum did India receive the Certificate of Elimination of Trachoma as a Public Health Problem from WHO?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**78th World Health Assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India receives WHO certification for elimination of Trachoma as Public Health Problem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** has been awarded the **Certificate of Elimination of Trachoma** as a **Public Health Problem**.

 
 
• 
 
The award was given by the **World Health Organisation (WHO)**.

 
 
• 
 
It was presented at the **78th World Health Assembly** in **Geneva**.

 
 
• 
 
This recognition shows India’s progress in **disease elimination** and **preventive healthcare**.

 
 
• 
 
On **October 8th** last year, WHO declared **India had eliminated Trachoma** as a public health issue.

 
 
• 
 
India is the **third country** in the **Southeast Asia region** to achieve this milestone.

 
 
• 
 
The success came under the **National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCBVI)**.

 
 
• 
 
The Government of India has shown a strong **commitment to health for all**.
